newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Karrie Ind seen in HK$70-80 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Karrie Ind seen in HK$70-80 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Hong Kong-based personal computer casings manufacturer Karrie Industrial Co Ltd is expected to raise HK$70 million to HK$80 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares, market sources said on Monday.
Market sources said proceeds raised are expected to be used for expansion of the company's manufacturing facilities.
The new issue is expected to price at a prospective price to earnings multiple of six to seven times but no further listing details are immediately available to the market, sources said.
Sources said the company's shares are expected to list in the middle of December. DBS Capital is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said.
